About Polygon

POL is the native token of Polygon, which replaced MATIC 1:1 in 2024. It secures Polygon PoS and is used across Polygon's payments and AggLayer infrastructure.

Where this POL price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (POL-USD), Binance (POL/USDT) and Kraken (POL/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 10.64B POL (supply last updated October 30, 2026). Prices on different exchanges can differ slightly; the table above shows each one and the spread between them.

Polygon previously traded under the ticker MATIC; old MATIC links on this site redirect here.
